description:
Read any text (e.g. an AI answer) and return the competitor brands it names and the sentiment toward the brand (positive | neutral | negative). Skips the brand, AI assistants and search engines cited as sources, and platforms the work runs on. The extractor audits use.

Billing: free — uses no AuditAE credit and works at a zero balance.

When to call: to classify an answer you already have, without paying for engine checks.

Returns { competitors, sentiment, charged_cents: 0, error? } (error: it couldn't run; competitors is empty).

brand.description: Brand of interest, as written in prose (up to 200 characters).

question.description: The question the text answers (sharpens what counts as a competitor).

text.description: Text to analyze, e.g. an AI engine's answer, up to 20,000 characters (send the relevant part of a longer one).

name: extract_competitors_from_text
title: Extract competitors and sentiment from AI-generated text
